Cindy Yen Promotional Portrait

Cindy Yen, the Houston-born Taiwanese singer-songwriter and actress, is captured in a striking studio portrait. She wears a purple satin blazer with a contrasting black lapel, her dark hair swept across her face. Vibrant red and blue lighting washes over the frame, creating a dramatic, high-fashion atmosphere.

Known for writing and producing her own albums—such as her 2009 debut and the electronic dance–infused 2011 release 2 Be Different—Cindy has also acted in TV dramas like Invaluable Treasure 1949 and films including The First Time. Cindy Yen Wears AWNL Meteorite Necklace

Taiwanese singer Cindy Yen models a Swedish AWNL Flipped meteorite necklace in a refined studio portrait. Dressed in a black halter dress, her soft waves frame a contemplative expression as she tilts her head, drawing attention to the pendant’s subtle shimmer. The minimalist background and monochrome styling emphasize the necklace’s craftsmanship and luxury appeal.

source.description:
Cindy Yen smiles brightly against a soft blue backdrop, holding a branch of fluffy cotton. The Chinese title “我愛我自己” and English phrase “love myself” appear alongside her name “Cindy 袁詠琳,” reinforcing the theme of self-love.

Released by JVR Music, the single “I Love Myself” follows her 2015 album “Fight For Love” and features lyrics by Vincent Fang. The cover’s fresh, confident imagery echoes the song’s message that true love begins with self-confidence and self-care.
